# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta28

## History selection pulse
- Keep the selected History session highlighted after it is chosen, but run the glow pulse only from the user's session click.
- Rebuilding the selected-session SVG during a later map/live refresh no longer recreates the animation state, so Chrome does not replay the pulse just because the map rerendered.
- Apply the same click-only pulse contract to Single and Multi mower History views.

## Zoom and pan
- Stop recurring map payload refreshes from resetting the user viewport.
- Add a real interaction-owned zoom/pan auto-reset timer: it starts after wheel zoom or after a pan/pinch gesture ends, and resets only after **30 seconds** of inactivity.
- Add **Auto-reset zoom after 30 seconds** to the card editor. It is enabled by default; disable it to keep the current zoom/pan position until the user changes it or the card is reopened.
- Existing `initial_zoom`, `initial_focus`, `remember_view` and `max_zoom` settings remain compatible.

## Quick settings
- Rename the user-facing **Settings** dialog/button to **Quick settings** so it is clearer that this surface exposes only selected Home Assistant entity controls.
- Keep all existing YAML/internal keys such as `show_settings_button` and `settings_entity_*` unchanged.

## Compatibility
- No backend change is required for these frontend changes.
- Existing card YAML remains compatible.
